ABOUT

A press the size of a desk

Polyester Publishing is one desk, one editor, and a rotating cast of illustrators and friends. We make books slowly and in small numbers. Some are printed. Some are drawn and animated so that the reader gets to choose what the hero does next, and lives with the result.

We are not a platform, a marketplace, or a service. We are a press.

SUBMISSIONS

Send us a story

We read short manuscripts and story treatments a few times a year. Keep it under 3,000 words, tell us in one line why it needs to exist, and expect a slow reply. Submissions are by post or by invitation; we will publish an address here when the next reading window opens.
